newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Central Bank chief hurt in car accident.
newsitem.headline: Chile Central Bank chief hurt in car accident.

text.p: Chilean Central Bank President Carlos Massad suffered a broken arm Monday when his car was rammed by another on a crowded Santiago avenue, the bank said.
Massad was being treated for the fracture in a hospital and was in good condition after the crash in the Providencia neighborhood, said a brief statement from the bank.
Massad, who took office in September, is responsible for Chilean monetary policy.
The statement did not say if the Central Bank chief was being driven by a chauffer, as is generally the case, or was driving himself.
